analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 과매도 구간 진입(-1.7% 하락), MACD 히스토그램 악화 지속(-110.0484). 5일 저가 75,355원, 20일 저가 75,355원으로 동일하나 5일 고가 83,510원, 20일 고가 97,285원으로 Lower High 패턴 확인. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 1.45배로 증가했으나, 하락 추세 강화 신호.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI entered oversold territory (-1.7% drop), and MACD histogram continued to worsen (-110.0484). The 5-day low is 75,355, same as the 20-day low, but the 5-day high of 83,510 is lower than the 20-day high of 97,285, confirming a Lower High pattern. Volume increased by 1.45x the 5-day average, but this signals a strengthening downtrend.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (₩75,740) vs SMA5 (₩78,472)/SMA20 (₩84,567)/SMA50 (₩95,482): below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position relative to SMA100 (₩102,442)/SMA200 (₩101,109): below long-term trends, strongly bearish.
· 52-week position (22.1%) + current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.0→33.6): entering oversold, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (83.5308→-110.0484): worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band ₩73,218): approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (₩75,565): close to 20-day low, short-term support expected.
· Swing resistance (₩86,590): resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): confirms continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.45x): increased but signals strengthening downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): bearishness persists, conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
